Rule 28 The financial concurrence of the Finance Department shall be obtained before any new item of expenditure is sanctioned by a Department.
Rule 12 Cases involving development schemes shall be submitted to the Chief Minister through the Chief Secretary for orders.
Section 17 The competent authority may sanction a development scheme within the limits of the financial powers delegated to it.
Preamble In exercise of the powers conferred by the Constitution, the Government of Sindh makes the following rules.
